attributes.$control__question: Do the agents send anything without me?
attributes.$control__answer: No. Emails, Slack messages, refunds and cancellations all wait in your draft queue until you approve them. Sensitive outbound needs two-step approval.
Connecting your first tools takes a few minutes each — OAuth, pick the workspace, done. Agents start producing briefs the next morning.

attributes.$control__question: Is there a limit on integrations?
attributes.$control__answer: No. Every plan connects all 12+ live integrations. Plans differ by how many agents operate across them.
Data stays in your connected tools. Allel reads what it needs per workflow and logs every action in an inspectable audit trail.
